essence: Authorization to write comes from command or auspicious dream, and the wise one acts on it.
Performing the installation of life in the diagram is the means by which the desired fruit is obtained.
The diagram requires the accusative target in the center and the kuru-pair on both sides.
The syllables of this haṃsaḥ-sohaṃ mantra must be written individually in sequence.
The two ṭha syllables must be written on the left side in proper sequence from the start.
